description: Bundled offline advisory dataset for passive version-to-CVE matching. Only includes well-known, high-impact vulnerabilities with clear version boundaries. Used for passive hints only; not a substitute for a full vulnerability scanner.

cves.title: RegreSSHion: Signal handler race condition in OpenSSH
cves.description: A signal handler race condition in OpenSSH's privileged child process can lead to remote unauthenticated code execution as root on glibc-based Linux systems.

cves.title: OpenSSH forwarded ssh-agent double-free
cves.description: A double-free vulnerability in the ssh-agent forwarding feature could allow remote code execution.

cves.title: nginx HTTP/3 QUIC stack memory corruption
cves.description: Memory corruption in the HTTP/3 QUIC implementation could lead to worker process crashes or potential code execution.

cves.title: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset (nginx)
cves.description: HTTP/2 stream cancellation attack allowing DoS via rapid stream resets.

cves.title: Apache HTTP Server mod_proxy SSRF
cves.description: Server-side request forgery in mod_proxy when handling certain URI patterns.

cves.title: Apache HTTP Server HTTP/2 DoS
cves.description: HTTP/2 rapid reset DoS vulnerability.

cves.title: IIS OLE Remote Code Execution
cves.description: Remote code execution via malicious OLE object in web content.

cves.title: OpenSSL TLS session ticket DoS
cves.description: Memory exhaustion via crafted TLS session tickets.

cves.title: OpenSSL X.509 certificate parsing DoS
cves.description: Excessive resource consumption when parsing malicious certificate chains.

cves.title: MySQL Server DoS via crafted packets
cves.description: Unauthenticated DoS via malformed protocol packets.

cves.title: PostgreSQL privilege escalation via pg_dump
cves.description: Improper privilege handling in pg_dump allows object creation with elevated privileges.

cves.title: Redis Lua sandbox escape
cves.description: Lua sandbox escape allowing arbitrary code execution as the Redis user.

cves.title: MongoDB authentication bypass
cves.description: Authentication bypass under specific configuration conditions.

cves.title: vsftpd denial of service via malformed commands
cves.description: DoS via crafted FTP command sequences causing worker hang.

cves.title: ProFTPD mod_copy arbitrary file read

cves.title: PHP CGI argument injection
cves.description: Argument injection in PHP CGI mode on Windows allowing remote code execution.
